KelapaKu

Single-page brand site explaining how coconuts become four product lines.

  • StatusLive
  • CategoryBrand site
  • Year2026
  • Stack5 technologies

Overview

KelapaKu is a one-page brand site that explains how coconuts sourced from local growers are processed into fresh coconut, peeled coconut, copra and shell charcoal.

Problem

A commodity business spread across several product lines needs one clear explanation of its supply chain — for buyers, partners and the community around it.

Approach

A static, single-page site built with the Next.js App Router and exported as plain files, served from GitHub Pages on a custom domain.

What is implemented

  • Single page covering four product lines: fresh coconut, peeled coconut, copra and shell charcoal.
  • Static export — the build produces plain files with no server runtime.
  • Deployed on GitHub Pages at kelapaku.my.id.

Contribution

Public repository under Dika's GitHub account (9 commits), from interface through static export configuration.

Architecture and data flow

Next.js 15 with the App Router and output: "export", so the production build is a directory of static files rather than a running server. React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4 handle the interface, with Framer Motion for transitions.

Stack

Next.js 15 React 19 Tailwind CSS 4 Framer Motion TypeScript

Live site ↗ Source code ↗

Known limitations

  • Static brand page: no ordering, inventory or account system lives in this repository.
